decks.notes: This Canadian Threshold deck focuses on playing aggressively with efficient threats like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Daze and Force of Will. The deck uses cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to manipulate the top of the deck and maintains tempo with cards like Lightning Bolt and Wasteland. The deck also includes a touch of control with cards like Force of Negation and Counterbalance to further disrupt the opponent's plans and secure victory through relentless pressure.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the Dark Depths combo to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token. It utilizes cards like Knight of the Reliquary, Crop Rotation, and Thespian's Stage to tutor for and copy Dark Depths. The deck also includes various interaction and protection cards like Swords to Plowshares, Sylvan Safekeeper, and Endurance to ensure the combo goes off smoothly. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful 20/20 token that can end the game in just one swing.

The key concept of this Grixis Aggro deck is to aggressively control the board and pressure the opponent with efficient threats and disruption. By using cards like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to quickly close out the game while also utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt and Orcish Bowmasters to remove opposing threats. The deck also includes necessary card selection and disruption spells like Brainstorm, Force of Will, and Daze to maintain tempo and protect its threats. Overall, the deck focuses on applying pressure while maintaining control of the game.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with an army of fast and aggressive goblins. It utilizes cards like Muxus, Goblin Grandee and Goblin Ringleader to draw more goblins and maintain pressure on the opponent. With acceleration from cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Skirk Prospector, as well as mana generation from cards like City of Traitors and Ancient Tomb, this deck aims to put out early threats and control the board to secure victory through sheer force and speed.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the game by constantly disrupting the opponent while maintaining a fast tempo and applying pressure with efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck utilizes a mix of countermagic, removal spells, and card filtering to maintain board control and protect its threats. With a mana base focused on blue and red sources, the deck aims to tempo out opponents and close out games quickly before they have a chance to stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler to put pressure on the opponent quickly. The deck also includes efficient control elements such as Counterspell and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of card draw and selection spells like Brainstorm and Ponder helps to ensure consistency in drawing the necessary cards. Overall, this deck aims to be a highly interactive and proactive aggressive deck that can both apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategies effectively.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using lands to disrupt the opponent's strategy and establish a strong board presence. By using cards like Exploration, Crop Rotation, and Life from the Loam, it aims to ramp quickly and lock down the opponent with cards like Maze of Ith and Wasteland. The combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage provides a win condition, while Punishing Fire offers repeated removal. The deck also has toolbox lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and utility artifacts like Pithing Needle and Soul-Guide Lantern to adapt to different situations.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, using cards like Entomb and Reanimate. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo. The goal is to reanimate a big threat early in the game, overwhelming the opponent and securing a quick victory. The deck is designed to be efficient and aggressive, with the potential to win the game in just a few turns if the combo pieces come together smoothly.

Utilizing a combination of discard spells, reanimation spells, and disruptive cards, this deck aims to quickly bring back powerful creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent with threats they can't easily deal with. The deck focuses on efficient spells and card advantage to fuel its combo pieces, while also including disruptive elements like counterspells and land destruction to control the game state. By carefully managing resources and timing, the deck can consistently execute its combo and win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this Dragon Stompy deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Chalice of the Void while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Broadside Bombardiers and Goblin Rabblemaster. The deck aims to control the board and limit the opponent's resources, allowing for fast and efficient wins through direct damage and hasty creatures. This aggressive strategy is supported by mana acceleration cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, as well as powerful finishers like Fury and Shatterskull Smashing.

The main focus of this Grixis Aggro deck is to quickly put pressure on the opponent through efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, supported by disruption spells like Lightning Bolt and Wasteland. The deck aims to control the board early on with cards like Murktide Regent and Force of Will, while also maintaining card advantage with Brainstorm and Ponder. By utilizing a mix of aggression and disruption, the deck looks to outpace and overpower opponents in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly through cards like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual, and then casting a high number of spells in a single turn to build up storm count. This allows the player to finish off their opponent with a lethal Tendrils of Agony. The deck also utilizes cards like Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize for disruption and protection, while utilizing cards like Entomb and Echo of Eons for card advantage. The deck's win condition revolves around casting Tendrils of Agony for lethal damage.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt opponents' mana bases and lock them out of casting spells using cards like Magus of the Moon, Blood Moon, and Chalice of the Void. By ramping out powerful threats like Goblin Rabblemaster and Fury early on with fast mana sources like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents and close out the game quickly. The inclusion of cards like Unlicensed Hearse and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional aggression and disruption to push through for a victory.

This deck is focused on utilizing powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Orcish Bowmasters along with disruptive spells like Daze and Stifle to quickly overwhelm and disrupt the opponent. The deck also features graveyard synergies with Reanimate and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck aims to control the board and apply pressure to the opponent with efficient creatures and disruptive spells, while also having the ability to quickly recover resources with cards like Brainstorm and Force of Will.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently get big creatures into play from the graveyard using cards like Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Entomb. These creatures like Archon of Cruelty, Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and Troll of Khazad-dûm can then be used to overwhelm and defeat the opponent. The deck utilizes a mix of counter spells like Force of Will and disruption effects like Grief to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The Wasteland, Daze, and Brazen Borrower also help control the board and disrupt the opponent's plans.

The deck focuses on aggressive tactics with a heavy emphasis on Goblin creatures. It aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of Goblins and utilize cards like Muxus, Goblin Grandee and Goblin Matron to search for key pieces. The deck also includes mana acceleration sources like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide to quickly deploy threats, along with disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void to control the game. The deck aims to utilize its explosive starts to outpace the opponent and close out the game quickly.
